sources.snippet: This project explores the use of deep learning and machine learning techniques for melanoma risk classification using dermoscopic skin lesion images and patient clinical metadata. The system combines image-based feature extraction using a pretrained ResNet18 convolutional neural network (CNN) with structured patient information including age, sex, and anatomical site.
